_note: Original Mika World transformation language: an Aether Orbit sigil opens under the mage, light gathers in her hands while she speaks her words, an aura column rises as she lifts off the ground, a flash carries the form change, the mage's own orbit ring forms around her, a finishing pose, then back to play. Times in seconds; 'swap' is the flash peak where the avatar changes (the music cue's reveal hit is composed to land there). Camera shots are relative to the mage (radius/height in metres, yaw degrees from her facing, look = 'face' | 'chest' | 'hands' | 'feet'). No third-party sequences, symbols, poses or music. Gestures/poses avoid clips that rotate the hips (wide_arm_spell), and each shot is anchored to the mage's visual facing (from her shoulders) when the shot begins. The form reached at a tenth level is PERMANENT (saved appearance); 'surge_s' is the length of the temporary Orbit Surge (power + orbit ring) a mage may call before a strong fight. Milestone J: the FIRST awakening (full) is an 11.6 s, five-stage sequence (versions.full.stages): 1 awakening (she senses it; ambient light gathers), 2 build-up (orbit frames rise and turn, she lifts off, speaks her words), 3 clothing reveal (a cocoon of light ribbons wraps her feet-to-head, the form changes inside it, then the ribbons unravel head-to-feet so the outfit appears progressively - never an abrupt swap or a white-out), 4 Aether Orbit awakening (arc segments and beads fly in and lock into her first orbit), 5 final reveal (landing, finishing pose on the musical climax, clear full-body shot). Music: tools/audio/synth_milestone_j.py transform. Camera rule (Milestone J): no low angles on a mage at close range - every shot is at least 1.0 m high (a skirt lifted by spring bones during the lift-off must never be framed from below).
